user.title: hasspy
user.description: Add the hasspy bridge. This is a local sink that a hasspy runtime publishes entities into; no settings are required.

register_bridge.name: Register bridge
register_bridge.description: Announce a hasspy process. Idempotent; safe to call on every (re)connect.

name.name: Name
name.description: Human-readable name shown on the device.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: Default scope for entities created without one.

run_id.name: Run id
run_id.description: Opaque id that changes on every process start.

stale_after.name: Stale after
stale_after.description: Seconds without a heartbeat before the bridge counts as offline.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Keep a bridge alive and refresh its automation list.

remove_bridge.name: Remove bridge
remove_bridge.description: Forget a bridge, optionally deleting all of its entities.

log.name: Log
log.description: Log a line from a hasspy automation. Stored on the bridge's last_log sensor, mirrored to the HA log, and written to the logbook.

logbook.name: Logbook
logbook.description: Also write it to the HA logbook timeline.

create_entity.name: Create entity
create_entity.description: Create or update a dynamic entity (value or control). Returns its entity_id.

automation.name: Automation
automation.description: Owning app instance id, for grouping and lifecycle.

key.name: Key
key.description: Stable key, unique within the automation.

domain.name: Domain
domain.description: sensor/binary_sensor are values (hasspy writes); number/select/switch/datetime are controls (the user edits).

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: production is permanent; debug is lease-managed (values only).

ttl.name: Lease TTL
ttl.description: Debug values only: seconds before the entity goes stale.

pin.name: Pin
pin.description: Debug values only: exempt from garbage collection.

set_entity_state.name: Set entity state
set_entity_state.description: Push a state (and/or attributes) to a dynamic entity, refreshing its lease.

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: Also remove it from the registry.

list_bridges.name: List bridges
list_bridges.description: Return every registered bridge with its online state.

add_rule.name: Add one-shot rule
add_rule.description: Arm a trigger plus the action to run once when it fires. Returns the rule id and its entities.

name.name: Name
name.description: Human-readable name, also used as the rule sensor's name.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: A Home Assistant trigger config, e.g. platform numeric_state with entity_id and above.

action.name: Action
action.description: Either an entity_id plus value to write a control, or a service call with allow_any_action.

at.name: At
at.description: Absolute time: ISO-8601, or HH:MM for the next occurrence.

in.name: In
in.description: Relative delay: seconds, or a string like 5m or 2h.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.description: Optional owning bridge, used for grouping and logging.

key.name: Key
key.description: Optional stable key for the owning bridge.

allow_any_action.name: Allow any action
allow_any_action.description: Permit an arbitrary service call as the action instead of a control write.

fire_now_if_true.name: Fire now if already true
fire_now_if_true.description: Run the action immediately when the trigger condition already holds.

expires_in.name: Expires in
expires_in.description: Disarm the rule if it has not fired within this many seconds. Default 24 hours.

cancel_rule.name: Cancel one-shot rule
cancel_rule.description: Disarm a rule and mark it cancelled, or remove it entirely with forget.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Recorded in the rule's last_error field.

forget.name: Forget
forget.description: Delete the rule and its entities instead of just cancelling it.

list_rules.name: List one-shot rules
list_rules.description: Return armed and finished rules with their trigger and action descriptions.

release_session.name: Release debug session
release_session.description: Delete every debug entity of a bridge (or one automation) immediately. The graceful-shutdown path.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Run garbage collection now. dry_run returns the verdicts without deleting.

pin.name: Pin debug entities
pin.description: Exempt a bridge's (or automation's) debug entities from collection.
